summary.text: Ryan Sheridan is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 90, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democratic incumbent Mark Boyko is also on the ballot.
A nurse practitioner from Kirkwood, he also sought the Republican nomination for Missouri's 2nd Congressional District but did not appear on that primary ballot.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Sheridan attended Kirkwood High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri, Columbia, and a graduate degree from Missouri State University, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as nurse practitioner.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey for his congressional run, he described himself as a nurse practitioner, small business owner and Missourian from Kirkwood.
